title: Credential Workflow Status Changed Webhook Event Data
description: Schema for the eventData portion of credential_workflow.status.changed webhook events. This validates the data field that gets wrapped with eventType and timestamp by the consumer.

credentialingWorkflowId.description: Unique identifier for the credentialing workflow

previousStatusId.description: Unique identifier for the previous timeline event (null for first event)

previousStatusName.description: Previous timeline event status name (null for first event)

newStatusId.description: Unique identifier for the new timeline event

statusChangedAt.description: Timestamp when the status change occurred (ISO 8601 date-time format)

practitionerExternalId.description: External identifier from the practitioner object in the credential workflow (defaults to null if not present)
